Compaction uses the same Agent model authority.
The returned input, output, cache, total token, and USD cost fields
are persisted with the compaction completion event.
Summary calls have no tools or cache and use a fresh routing ID.
Recoverable LENGTH compares the same desired max output sent on the request.
